name: COUGAR POSEIDON ELITE ARGB 360 LIQUID COOLER
shortDescription: **COUGAR POSEIDON ELITE ARGB 360 LIQUID COOLER****Brand:** COUGAR  **Model:** POSEIDON ELITE ARGB 360  **Type:** All-in-One (AIO) Liquid CPU Cooler  **Radiator Size:** 360mm  ---**
descriptionHtml:
**COUGAR POSEIDON ELITE ARGB 360 LIQUID COOLER**


**Brand:** COUGAR  

**Model:** POSEIDON ELITE ARGB 360  

**Type:** All-in-One (AIO) Liquid CPU Cooler  

**Radiator Size:** 360mm  


---


**Radiator:**  

Dimensions: 394 x 120 x 27 mm  

Material: Aluminum  

Fin Type: Single Wave Fin  


---


**Water Block (CPU Block):**  

Dimensions: 82 x 69 x 55 mm  

Base Material: Copper  

Pump Speed: 3200 ± 10% RPM  

Pump Noise Level: < 28 dBA  

Pump Connector: 3-pin  

RGB Lighting: Addressable RGB (ARGB)  


---


**Tubes:**  

Length: 400 mm  

Material: Rubber + Reinforced Nylon Sleeve  

Tube Color: Black  


---


**Fans:**  

Model: COUGAR VORTEX ARGB 120  

Quantity: 3 fans  

Dimensions: 120 x 120 x 25 mm  

Fan Speed: 600 - 2000 RPM (±10%)  

Airflow: Up to 70.5 CFM (each fan)  

Static Pressure: Up to 2.67 mmH₂O  

Noise Level: < 32 dBA  

Bearing Type: Dynamic Hydraulic Bearing  

Fan Connector: 4-pin PWM  

RGB Connector: 3-pin ARGB (5V)  

RGB Lighting: Addressable RGB (fan blades + frame)  


---


**Compatibility (Sockets):**  


**Intel:**  

LGA 1700, LGA 1200, LGA 115X (1150, 1151, 1155, 1156), LGA 2066, LGA 2011  


**AMD:**  

AM5, AM4, AM3+, AM3, AM2+, AM2, FM2+, FM2, FM1  


---


**Technical Specifications:**  

Cooling Type: Liquid (water + anti-corrosion additive)  

Pump Power Consumption: 3.6W  

Fan Power Consumption: 2.4W (each fan)  

Rated Voltage (Pump): 12V DC  

Rated Voltage (Fan): 12V DC  

Rated Voltage (RGB): 5V DC  


---


**Features:**  

360mm radiator for high-performance cooling  

Addressable RGB lighting on pump and all fans  

PWM controlled fans for automatic speed adjustment  

Universal socket compatibility (Intel & AMD)  

Reinforced nylon tubes for durability  

Anti-leak technology  

Dynamic Hydraulic Bearing fans for quiet operation  

Mirrored pump top design with RGB lighting  


---


**Package Includes:**  

COUGAR POSEIDON ELITE ARGB 360 liquid cooler  

3 x COUGAR VORTEX ARGB 120 fans (pre-installed on radiator)  

Mounting kit for Intel and AMD sockets  

Thermal paste (pre-applied on copper base)  

User manual  

RGB controller hub


---


**Notes:**  

- Designed for high-end CPUs (Intel Core i9 / AMD Ryzen 9)  

- ARGB lighting requires a 5V 3-pin RGB header on the motherboard  

- Some versions include a dedicated RGB controller for motherboards without ARGB headers  

- Mirror pump top design creates an infinity mirror lighting effect  


-
